settings.label: Free shipping threshold ($)
settings.info: Cart subtotal at which free shipping unlocks. Must match your Shopify shipping profile.

settings.label: Gift-with-purchase threshold ($)
settings.info: Cart subtotal at which the free gift is added.

settings.label: Gift-with-purchase product
settings.info: The product that is automatically added as a free gift when the GWP threshold is reached. Set the product price to $0 in Shopify Admin.

settings.label: GWP product handle
settings.info: Shopify product handle for the GWP item. Must match the product handle in Shopify Admin.

settings.label: Klaviyo public API key
settings.info: Found in Klaviyo → Account → Settings → API Keys. Used for onsite identify and track calls.

settings.label: Klaviyo Flow webhook URL
settings.info: Shopify Flow webhook URL that triggers the receipt + 10% off email. Create a Flow with a webhook trigger in Shopify Admin → Flow.

settings.label: Google Maps JavaScript API key
settings.info: Restrict this key to your Shopify domain in Google Cloud Console. Used for address autocomplete on the checkout shipping step.

settings.label: Smile.io API key
settings.info: Found in Smile.io Admin → Apps → API. Used to fetch customer points balance and deduct redeemed points.

settings.label: Urgency bar text
settings.default: LIMITED OFFER — BUY 2 GET 1 FREE ENDS IN:
settings.info: Text shown in the announcement bar before the countdown timer.

settings.label: Urgency bar end date (ISO 8601)
settings.info: ISO 8601 datetime string for the countdown timer target. Example: 2026-05-15T23:59:59

settings.label: Exit-intent promo code
settings.info: Promo code shown in the exit-intent overlay when the user tries to leave with items in the cart.
